provenance: The project's own slots for the scenario library (owner directive and approval, 2026-10-16). No slot copies a 1977 scenario card: the titles, the themes, the forces, and the victory conditions come from this file and from the seed of `sl-cli library`. The slots go up in rules, force size, and board count, as the printed set did.
note: points is the band of the defender point total on the scale of slcampaign.points; the attacker gets a share of it. vehicles is the percent of each budget that goes to vehicles. required names the counters that a side always gets, so the card can name them (2026-10-17). A slot with more than one board stacks the boards from north to south, so the front gets wider and the depth stays one board.

slots.name: grain_office
slots.title: The Grain Office
slots.theme: A grain office and its yards at the edge of a burned town. The defenders hold the office block, and the attackers must take it before dark.

slots.name: pump_house
slots.title: The Pump House
slots.theme: The pump house holds the water of the district. Assault engineers with a demolition charge and a flamethrower go in under smoke against a garrison that hides its strength.

slots.name: under_the_square
slots.title: Under the Square
slots.theme: The Germans hold the west end of a square, and the Russians hold the east end. The Germans must take the east end, and the Russians must hold it. Below the square, a stack with a leader can go through the sewers from one entrance to the next, and the enemy cannot fire on it there.

slots.name: mill_road
slots.title: The Mill Road
slots.theme: The Mill Road runs from west to east through a village. The defenders hold the mill. The attackers have armored vehicles, and the defenders have armor of their own.

slots.name: orchard_line
slots.title: The Orchard Line
slots.theme: A village with two orchards. Part of the defending force sets up hidden.

slots.name: the_crest
slots.title: The Crest
slots.theme: Hill country with woods and a few buildings. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end.

slots.name: hedgerows
slots.title: The Hedgerows
slots.theme: Fields cut by hedges. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end.

slots.name: village_and_hills
slots.title: Village and Hills
slots.theme: A village to the north and hill country to the south, on one front. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end of each.

slots.name: street_by_street
slots.title: Street by Street
slots.theme: A town to the north and a village to the south, on one front. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end of each.

slots.name: hills_and_fields
slots.title: Hills and Fields
slots.theme: Hill country to the north and open fields to the south, on one front. Each side has armored vehicles.

slots.name: three_sectors
slots.title: Three Sectors
slots.theme: A town, a village, and a range of hills on one front, from north to south.

slots.name: the_long_front
slots.title: The Long Front
slots.theme: Four sectors of one front, from north to south: a town, a village, hill country, and fields. The Americans hold the first three sectors, and the Russians hold the fourth.
